vocabulary.meaning_en: a room in a building where letters and packages arrive

vocabulary.meaning_en: a building or floor where people leave their cars

vocabulary.meaning_en: on the other side; facing

vocabulary.meaning_en: right beside

vocabulary.meaning_en: at the back of

vocabulary.meaning_en: before something; facing its front side

vocabulary.meaning_en: in that direction

vocabulary.meaning_en: very good; great (informal)

vocabulary.meaning_en: to get new knowledge

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do something together with someone

vocabulary.meaning_en: thank you (informal)

vocabulary.meaning_en: very good; also: big and important

fine_lines.title: across from vs next to vs behind
fine_lines.explanation_ar: next to = بجانب الشيء مباشرة (على نفس الجهة). across from = في الجهة المقابلة، وغالبًا بينهما شارع أو ممر. behind = في الخلف.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Next to means right beside something, on the same side. Across from means on the other side, often with a street or hallway between. Behind means at the back.

examples.sentence: The gym is next to the mailroom.
The gym is across from the lounge.
The gym is behind the lobby.

fine_lines.title: I'm good (= no, thank you)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I'm good / I'm fine تعني «أنا بخير» جوابًا لـ How are you?. لكن بعد دعوة أو عرض (Join me!) تعني I'm good بلطف: «لا، شكرًا».
fine_lines.explanation_en: I'm good / I'm fine answer 'How are you?'. But after an offer or invitation (Join me!), 'I'm good' is a polite way to say 'No, thank you'.

examples.sentence: How are you? I'm fine, thanks.
Do you want more tea? I'm good, thanks.

expressions.meaning_en: An informal way to say 'How are you?'.
A happy answer to 'How's it going?'.
expressions.example: How's it going? It's going great, thanks.
My new job? Things are awesome!

expressions.meaning_en: A question to find a place.
expressions.example: Excuse me, where is the lobby?

expressions.meaning_en: You are going in the wrong direction.
expressions.example: No, not that way! Go left.

expressions.meaning_en: Saying you are in the wrong place.

expressions.example: Is this the mailroom? That's right.

expressions.meaning_en: Come and do this with me.
expressions.example: I'm going for a walk. Join me!

expressions.meaning_en: Here: a polite way to say no.
expressions.example: Do you want to come? I'm good, thanks.

grammar.title: Prepositions of place: next to, across from, behind, in front of
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) نستخدم هذه الكلمات لنقول أين يوجد مكان أو شيء.
٢) الترتيب: The + مكان + is + حرف الجر + the + مكان آخر.
٣) The gym is next to the mailroom. (بجانب)
٤) The gym is across from the lounge. (مقابل)
٥) The gym is behind the lobby. (خلف) — وعكسها in front of (أمام).
grammar.explanation_en:
1) Use these words to say where a place or thing is.
2) Order: The + place + is + preposition + the + other place.
3) The gym is next to the mailroom.
4) The gym is across from the lounge.
5) The gym is behind the lobby. The opposite of behind is in front of.
examples: The café is next to the bank.
My house is across from the park.
The car is behind the building.
The bus stop is in front of the school.

grammar.title: This is ... / This is not ...
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) نستخدم This is للتعريف بمكان أو شيء قريب: This is the mailroom.
٢) للنفي نضيف not: This is not the gym.
٣) الاختصار في الكلام: This isn't the gym.
٤) نستخدم a مع مكان عام غير محدد (This is a rooftop) وthe مع مكان معروف (This is the gym).
grammar.explanation_en:
1) Use This is to name a place or thing near you: This is the mailroom.
2) For the negative, add not: This is not the gym.
3) Short form in speaking: This isn't the gym.
4) Use a for any place of that kind (This is a rooftop) and the for the place we both know (This is the gym).

questions.explanation_en: The opposite of behind is in front of.

questions.explanation_ar: بعد دعوة، I'm good تعني: لا، شكرًا.

questions.explanation_en: On the other side of the street = across from.
